cells.quote: An attractor state is a particular configuration of the system’s elements and contextual factors with feedback loops among them that reinforce one another, so that the system tends to keep re-emerging into that configuration. A repellor state is a configuration with feedback loops that induce critical fluctuations or tensions between elements, which propel change that pushes the system away from it, manifesting instability or transience.
